(T^0.5, T^3) dropped below about 6e-5, so the remaining error may also sit in the mixed term's exact form, not only the eps-only term.

The best recorded candidate is `params[0]*eps/(1+params[1]*eps) + params[2]*T**params[3] + params[4]*T**params[5]/(1+params[6]*eps**params[7])`, with NMSE 2.558e-5.
